sprites.prompt:
Create a true TRANSPARENT pixel-art character animation sprite sheet, with real alpha outside the character. EXACTLY 6 columns by 6 rows =36 evenly spaced cells in a perfect square canvas. Six COMPLETE characters across every row and six rows down. NO BACKGROUND SCENE, floor, furniture, desk, laptop, labels, borders, grid lines, checkerboard pattern or chroma color. All empty pixels truly transparent, including space between characters. Target3072x3072 pixels (512px square cells) if possible; correct6x6 grid takes priority over native resolution.

FIXED PRESENTATION:
Each character is centered at x50% of its own square cell, feet/base anchored at y85%; body roughly55% of cell width and60% of cell height. Keep ENTIRE character and any held prop inside its own cell with a generous safety margin. Top12% of EVERY cell fully transparent to clear status dots, even with raised hands, antenna or flags. The camera is fixed at a slightly elevated three-quarter view, character faces LOWER-LEFT. Consistent scale, body shape, palette, lighting and base location. Warm key light from RIGHT. Crisp square pixel clusters, clean dark outline, readable at200px. No cast shadows or semiopaque floor patches.

ANIMATION ROWS, six distinct sequential frames each, left to right:
1 SLEEPING: fully asleep in all six frames, eyes closed or device lights dim, gentle breathing loop. Small Z, ZZ, ZZZ, ZZZ, ZZ, Z sleep glyphs can float above the head but BELOW reserved top12%.
2 WAKING: frame1 asleep, frame2 stirs, frame3 startled eyes open/head rises, frame4 rises further, frame5 alert, frame6 alert blink. No Z glyphs in this row.
3 WORKING: six subtle sequential poses performing the described activity; loop seamlessly frame6 back to frame1. Anchored base.
4 ALARMED: normal, notice, eyes/lights widen, recoil, arms/body raised, final shocked open mouth if anatomy has a mouth. Use species-appropriate equivalent.
5 CELEBRATE: normal, smile starts, single fist pump or species equivalent, more pleased, final two frames both arms up and grin or appropriate anatomical equivalent. Feet/base anchored.
6 ANNOYED: normal, brow pinch or species equivalent, brow pinch, face-palm/head droop, face-palm with tiny head shake, face-palm return. Never invent limbs to perform a gesture.

Only characters and their explicitly described small held work props. No environmental objects. No typography or symbols except sleeping Z glyphs in row1. Exactly36 cells; never5or8columns. Keep the same character design and pose anchors in every cell. Preserve genuine transparent alpha.
